notes: Generated routing and basic-output starter. Curate realistic prompts and example-backed task scenarios before treating it as behavior evidence.

should_trigger.prompt: Please inspect one live opportunity and produce an evidence-backed manager view of stage validity, deal risk, missing proof, and next actions.
I need help with a specific deal review, stalled-deal diagnosis, or manager inspection.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable deal inspection and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build a concise forecast risk brief that highlights commit risk, slippage, and intervention priorities for sales leadership.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please build mutual action plans for complex deals and coordinated customer initiatives.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Produces Inspection Decision: objective, as-of date, current stage, stage-validity finding, and overall evidence confidence; Evidence Ledger: material claim, status, source, source date, conflict, and proof still needed.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
